description: Identifier linking this row to its source literature review record (from the Covidence systematic review tool). Non-literature rows (long-term monitoring, expert observations) are assigned a placeholder value of 666.

Internal identifier for the contributing dataset (e.g. FRIM, Lambir, Pasoh, Gunung_Palung, Bukit_Timah, Gunung_Tarak, BBBR, additional_contributed_obs, Literature_review). See site_data_summary.csv for the mapping to human-readable data source types.
Human-readable data source type: long-term monitoring, unpublished long-term, expert observations, or literature review.
Short-form citation of the literature source, e.g. 'Numata et al. 2012'. NA for non-literature rows.
Specific sub-location or plot name within the site, as originally reported by the data source (e.g. a named research plot). May differ in granularity from 'site'.
Canonical, harmonised site name. Matches the site names used in site_data_summary.csv.
World Database on Protected Areas identifier for the site, where available.
Latitude of the site, in decimal degrees.
Longitude of the site, in decimal degrees.
Broader administrative/geographic region containing the site.
Size of the monitoring plot or study area, in hectares, where reported.
Forest type classification for the site, where reported.

TRUE if this site-month marks the onset (first month) of a discrete flowering event, based on either explicit onset dates (literature review) or detection of a new run of active months following a gap (all other sources).
TRUE if this site-month marks the onset of a discrete fruiting event, using the same onset-detection logic as is_fl_onset.
The calendar month and year this row represents, as a formatted string (used to derive month_date).

The observed reproductive phenophase for this site-month: FL (flowering), FR (fruiting), or none (observed, but no flowering or fruiting recorded). NA if the month was not observed for this event_type.
Which phenophase this row's threshold/onset logic applies to: FL or FR. Long-term monitoring datasets contribute one row per site-month per event_type.

The numeric proportional threshold applied to classify this site-month as masting (FL/FR) vs. not, for datasets using proportional thresholding. NA for literature review and expert-observation rows, which report presence/absence directly rather than via a proportional threshold.
Observation method used to collect the underlying data, as reported by the source (e.g. binoculars, seed traps, canopy observation system).
The first day of the calendar month represented by this row, derived from current_month_year. Used as the primary date field for all time-series and onset analyses.
